stops.label: Front door
stops.does: In through the glass door on the left of the shopfront. From 23:30 to 07:00 it is locked: knock, and the night staff open the door.

stops.label: Check in
stops.does: At the café counter, which is also the front desk, show your passport and pay the 100,000 kip deposit for your padlock and towel. Luggage can wait beside the desk.

stops.label: Shoes off
stops.does: Take your shoes off at the foot of the stairs and carry them up.

stops.label: Shoes
stops.does: Leave your shoes in the cubbies on the 1st floor landing.

stops.label: Pod H01
stops.does: Find your pod by its number (H01 is a top bunk, up its ladder) and the locker with the same number. Keep your voice down: someone is always asleep.

stops.label: Shoes
stops.does: Take your shoes from the cubby and carry them down.

stops.label: Shoes on
stops.does: Put them on at the foot of the stairs.

stops.label: Breakfast
stops.does: Included, served at the counter from 08:00 to 10:30: two fried eggs, salad, baguette, fruit and coffee or tea. Eat it at a table in the café.

stops.label: Shoes
stops.does: Take your shoes and your bag; pack nothing in the dorm.

stops.label: Pack here
stops.does: Pack on the ground floor, beside the luggage space by the front desk, so the dorm can sleep on.

stops.label: Check out
stops.does: Told the team beforehand? Hand in your padlock and towel at the front desk and get the 100,000 kip deposit back.

stops.label: Front door
stops.does: Out through the glass door. While it is locked, the night staff open the door.

stops.label: Not here
stops.does: No smoking on the terrace or at the café’s front: the smoke drifts straight inside.

stops.label: Smoke here
stops.does: A few steps further out, by the small jar for cigarette butts.

water.name: From the counter to the free water

stops.label: Free water
stops.does: Free drinking water at the dispenser, at the start of the corridor, with glasses in the cupboard below.

bathroom-women.name: From Dorm H to the women’s bathroom

stops.label: Women’s bathroom
stops.does: The women’s bathroom is on the 1st floor, past the stairs: its door is by the right wall. The sinks are on your right; turn left for the showers and the toilets.

stops.label: Café
stops.does: Look over the tables, the counter and the floor, and clean what needs it.

stops.label: Toilet
stops.does: The toilet, its sink and the corridor basin: cleaned and refilled.

stops.label: Landing
stops.does: Tidy the shoe cubbies and sweep the landing.

stops.label: Bathroom
stops.does: Toilets, showers, basins and floor: cleaned and refilled.

stops.label: Dorm H
stops.does: Quietly: the aisle, the floor and the bins; pods made up fresh after check-out.

stops.label: Bathroom
stops.does: Toilets, showers, basins and floor: cleaned and refilled.

stops.label: Dorm J
stops.does: Quietly: the aisle, the floor and the bins; pods made up fresh after check-out.
